video_title: A BATTLE FOR THE AGES 🍿 Keys to Spurs vs. Thunder Game 7 🔑 | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's motivation to prove he is the world's best player
quotes.excerpt: He was determined to come into the series and prove that he was the best player in the world.
quotes.quote: Let's go back to Game 1, pre-game. There's a ceremony, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander getting that MVP trophy. You saw Victor Wembanyama sitting over there on the Spurs bench and he was seething. In his mind, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was getting a trophy that belonged to him. He was determined to come into the series and prove that he was the best player in the world. That night, 41 points, 24 rebounds, it's a heck of a start. In three games this series, there has been no question that Victor Wembanyama was the most dominant force on the floor. If he can do that one more time tonight, then he can rip the crown off Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's head and stake his claim as the best player in the game.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Richardson
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander needs to prioritize high-quality shots in Game 7
quotes.excerpt: He has to get closer to his spots. He's a mid-range nightmare.

text_blocks.speaker: Quentin Richardson
text_blocks.text: He just needs to be who he is, the MVP of the league, the back-to-back MVP of the league. He's got to get some better quality shots because last game he had a lot of one-on-one toughs. I think they mixed it up and caught him off guard with that because they have been doing so much doubling. Steph Castle has done a great job individually, but make no bones about it, he has to get closer to his spots. He's a mid-range nightmare. He has to get to more high-quality shots in that mid-range, get more shots to the basket. I think the offense has to create opportunities for him to be getting downhill with Victor Wembanyama away from the hole and then he can get rolling if he gets a couple mid-range to inside shots.

text_blocks.speaker: Hannah Storm
text_blocks.text: And as we just talked about also, the Thunder are shorthanded, no Jalen Williams, no Josh Giddey, down two guys that they have really depended upon. Who has to step up for OKC tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Quentin Richardson
text_blocks.text: I'm looking for Alex Caruso, Jared McCain, and Cason Wallace to be huge. Huge guys that help off the bench. I'm not sure if Jared McCain will be starting tonight or not, like he did last game, but either way, I look for those three guys to be guys that are huge contributors, especially here at home. All of these guys play a lot better at home and the last few games it's been back-and-forth with the home team winning and those guys have all played well at home. So I think I think Alex Caruso, Cason Wallace, and definitely Jared McCain need to step up and have big nights for them for them to win tonight.
